Article.ArticleTitle: Erlotinib treatment in non-small cell lung cancer.

Abstract.AbstractText: Erlotinib was effective in the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer patients. Rash was a common adverse effect of erlotinib. Erlotinib inhibits EGFR signalling in vitro.

Article.ArticleTitle: Gefitinib did not improve survival in breast cancer.

Abstract.AbstractText: Gefitinib did not improve survival in breast cancer patients.
